assessment criterion

  • CURIE: gmeow:assessmentCriterion
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/assessmentCriterion
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms

The criterion applied. Functional: a 21-axis scoring pass is 21 Assessments (zeros included — a zero is a score, not an absence). Plays the observationMethod role without the subproperty axiom (claimModality pattern). An assessment names a criterion or a rubric, or both (SHACL).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Assessment -> gmeow:Criterion; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:assessmentCriterion from gmeow:Assessment to gmeow:Criterion when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Assessment, gmeow:Criterion
